name: card/logo-wall
title: Logo wall
title_vi: Tường logo khách hàng (ký hiệu thay thế)
desc_vi: Một tường các ô logo thay thế (hai chữ cái) hiện lần lượt theo thứ tự, mỗi ô mờ rồi phóng nhẹ vào đúng chỗ; giữ yên, cuối clip mờ đi.
params_vi: heading: dòng tiêu đề trên tường · rows: 2 đến 4 hàng · cols: 3 đến 6 cột · stagger: ms giữa hai ô (20 đến 75) · marks: các ký hiệu, cách nhau dấu phẩy (hai chữ cái, thay bằng logo của khách) · duration: độ dài gốc 5 s · bg, fg, muted, surface, border: màu · radius: bo góc ô (px)
notes: Layout and motion as in the source: stage 86cqw x 82cqh with 3cqh gap and padding, heading min(2.6cqw, 4.4cqh) weight 650 tracking .08em uppercase with a 8cqw x 0.14cqw rule on both sides (the source's ::before / ::after, here two real spans), grid rows x cols with a 1.6cqh gap, cells with a 0.14cqw border, surface fill and a 0 1.2cqh 3cqh shadow, lettermark tile min(5.5cqw, 9.5cqh) with radius x 0.72, text min(2.2cqw, 4cqh) weight 800; cells opacity 0 -> 1 and scale 0.94 -> 1 over 0.55 s power2.out in DOM order, `stagger` ms apart, from 0.15 s (one tween per cell: the source used one tween with stagger { each, from: start }, which the builder cannot write out, it reads the stagger total back as the duration); the stage fades out over 0.5 s power2.in at `duration` - 0.5 s; IN 2.5 s and OUT 0.5 s scale together (stagger too) when `duration` is below 3 s. All cqw / cqh converted to px from the target box. Differences: the lettermarks are the source's own placeholders (AX, BL, CY ... 24 of them, a param list; more cells than marks get generated lettermarks); the cell radius is a px param (default 18, the source demo theme; the source fallback 2cqw is huge in a full-frame box); theme tokens bg, fg, muted, surface, border are params with the source demo theme as default (bg only tints the cell shadow and the mark text); the source's full-box background is not painted; color-mix(fg 72%, transparent) written as rgba. The demo shows 4 x 6 cells at 75 ms (the source demo's values). Default heading is Vietnamese (source: Trusted by teams).
